_readme: PBR texture overrides for the runway stage.
Find material IDs using the poly inspector in the viewer:
1. Click on a triangle in the 3-D view
2. The pop-up 'Summary' tab shows the 'material:' number
All texture paths are relative to 'basePath'.
heightScale defaults to 0 (displacement disabled on low-poly N64 mesh).
Set it to a small positive value (e.g. 4.0) to enable displacement.

overrides.name: snow_cliff
overrides._comment: Replace cliff / mountain polygon textures with hi-res PBR maps.  Fill in the materialIds array after inspecting the triangles you want to upgrade.
